title: 🚀 Extension Challenge — Your Own Login
subtitle: Let each user set their own username and password, then check it.
instructions: Steps 1 and 2 are already done for you. Replace each ??? in Step 3 so the login only grants access when someone enters back exactly what they set.
starterCode:
# LOGIN SIMULATION - EXTENSION CHALLENGE
# Morpheus Security Systems

# Step 1: Let the user set their own login
set_username = input("Set your username: ")
set_password = input("Set your password: ")

# Step 2: Try logging in
username = input("Username: ")
password = input("Password: ")

# Step 3: Check the login
# Replace each "???" with the correct variable
if username == "???" and password == "???":
    print("Access granted")
else:
    print("Access denied")
hints: You collected two usernames and two passwords — one when setting up, one when logging in.
Compare the login attempt to what was set, not to a fixed word like "agent".
== compares two variables' values, just like you did with the fixed password in Mission 2. Remove the quotes once you've swapped in the variable name.
successMessage: Well done! Now test it twice: once entering matching details (Access granted), once entering different details (Access denied). Then close and reopen the sandbox — notice it's forgotten everything.
